8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: The Maroon Palace was empty save for a few cleaning staff. I entered my office to find Lucian already waiting for me.

9.speaker: Narrator
9.text: The Maroon Palace was empty save for a few cleaning staff. I entered my office and was shocked to see Lucian already there, waiting for me.

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: I couldn't sleep, so I decided I might as well head to the palace early and get some uninterrupted work done.

11.speaker: Lucian Galade
11.text: "Mr. President. Good. I was hoping you'd be early."

12.speaker: Player
12.text: "Lucian, I know you're punctual, but this is ridiculous!"

14.speaker: Lucian Galade
14.text: "Mr. President. Thank you for meeting with me at this hour."

17.speaker: Lucian Galade
17.text: "Very well. I'm pleased that you chose to call me after your conversation with Mr. Vectern last night -- although I was already aware of his illicit relationship with Miss Suno."

18.speaker: Player
18.text: "I figured as much. You do know everything that goes on in the Palace, after all."

22.speaker: Lucian Galade
22.text: "On its own, given Mr. Vectern's established reputation as something of a playboy, the affair is unlikely to cause much damage. However, a more troubling possibility has been brought to light."

26.speaker: Lucian Galade
26.text: "A recent conversation with Mr. Hailstone, our whistleblower from Rumburg, revealed the presence of a spy within the Maroon Palace."

27.speaker: Lucian Galade
27.text: "For some time now, I have privately suspected the presence of an intelligence leak coming from within the Maroon Palace."

28.speaker: Lucian Galade
28.text: "I have a sensitive matter to discuss."

29.speaker: Lucian Galade
29.text: "I have very good reason to believe your vice president and your secretary are engaging in illicit relations."

30.speaker: Player
30.text: "Yes, he told me. It's over now."

33.speaker: Narrator
33.text: Lucian gave me a wounded look.

34.speaker: Lucian Galade
34.text: "You knew, and you didn't come to me with this information?"

35.speaker: Player
35.text: "I assumed you were already aware. You do know everything that goes on in this palace, after all."

36.speaker: Player
36.text: "I don't need your help. We've got this under control."

37.speaker: Player
37.text: "He only told me yesterday. I was going to come to you first thing today."

43.speaker: Lucian Galade
43.text: "I'm sorry to be the bearer of this news."

44.speaker: Lucian Galade
44.text: "Well, don't hesitate to call straight away next time."

45.speaker: Lucian Galade
45.text: "I believe Miss Suno is our mole. She has been using her relationship with Mr. Vectern to gather information."

50.speaker: Narrator
50.text: Lucian reached into his coat pocket, pulled out an audio tape and fed it into the reel-to-reel machine on my desk.

51.speaker: Lucian Galade
51.text: "This was recorded in the Palace at 18:09 on the second day of your trade visit to Lespia."

58.speaker: Lucian Galade
58.text: "This was recorded in the Palace at 18:09 following our return from the meeting with Deivid Wisci in Benfi."

60.text: He pressed play. I heard Petr and Livia's voices.

61.speaker: Livia Suno
61.text: "You're sure everyone's gone for the day?"

62.speaker: Petr Vectern
62.text: "Relax, Liv. Nobody's working that hard with Anton off in Lespia."

63.speaker: Petr Vectern
63.text: "Relax, Liv. Nobody's working that hard with Anton off in Valgsland."

67.text: Livia giggled. I heard the sound of kissing, then of drinks being poured.

68.speaker: Narrator
68.text: Livia giggled. I heard the sound of kissing, then of drinks being poured.

70.speaker: Lucian Galade
70.text: "I wish I was wrong, sir. But I've just come into possession of this."

71.speaker: Lucian Galade
71.text: "I can do better than that -- I'll show you."

72.speaker: Livia Suno
72.text: "Did he tell you how it's going over there? Do you think there's a chance they'll form an alliance?"

73.speaker: Livia Suno
73.text: "Did he tell you why he decided not to make a deal with Lespia or Valgsland? He's not interested in forming any alliances?"

74.speaker: Petr Vectern
74.text: "As a matter of fact, yes. He and Prime Minister Alvarez just sealed the deal."

81.speaker: Petr Vectern
81.text: "As a matter of fact, yes. He and Secretary Hegel just sealed the deal."

82.speaker: Petr Vectern
82.text: "The embargo diminished our chances with United Contana. Although we've still got a shot with Arcasia."
82.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Diplomacy_EmbargoingArcasia"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Diplomacy_EmbargoingUnitedContana"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Diplomacy_EmbargoingUnitedContana"] == true)

83.speaker: Petr Vectern
83.text: "Ah, something about staying as neutral as possible. Although even Iosef is saying we should find allies to deter Rumburg."

84.speaker: Petr Vectern
84.text: "But speaking of forming alliances, Miss Suno..."

85.speaker: Narrator
85.text: Lucian grimaced and switched the tape off.

88.speaker: Player
88.text: "Curiosity about foreign relations doesn't make one a spy."

90.speaker: Lucian Galade
90.text: "You don't need to hear the rest of it. The important question is, why so much curiosity about these particular alliances, if not because they could strengthen us against Rumburg?"

92.speaker: Lucian Galade
92.text: "Perhaps, but why so much curiosity about these particular alliances, if not because they could strengthen us against Rumburg?"

93.speaker: Lucian Galade
93.text: "Think about it. Why so much curiosity about these particular alliances, if not because they could strengthen us against Rumburg?"

94.speaker: Narrator
94.text: Just then, there was a knock on the door. Livia opened it cautiously.

95.speaker: Livia Suno
95.text: "Good morning, Mr. President, Mr. Galade. I didn't realize you'd be in so early. Can I get you some coffee?"

98.speaker: Player_Italic
98.text: Wait for Lucian to say something.

100.speaker: Narrator
100.text: Livia left to make coffee. A few minutes later, she came back and served the coffee.

104.speaker: Livia Suno
104.text: "I... I'm not sure what you're talking about."

105.speaker: Player
105.text: "Come on, Livia. Petr already told me everything."

108.speaker: Narrator
108.text: Livia buried her face in her hands.

109.speaker: Livia Suno
109.text: "I'm so sorry, Mr. President. I was foolish, and Petr was so nice to me... But it's over now. Nobody ever needs to know--"

110.speaker: Lucian Galade
110.text: "That's not what the President means, Miss Suno. We're referring to you being an intelligence agent for Rumburg."

111.speaker: Narrator
111.text: Livia sat upright. She looked shocked.

112.speaker: Livia Suno
112.text: "Pardon me, Mr. Galade, but are you feeling all right?"

113.speaker: Player
113.text: "No, he isn't. You'll have to excuse him."

114.speaker: Player
114.text: "Don't play dumb, Livia. If that is your real name."

115.speaker: Player
115.text: "He's fine. What do you have to say for yourself?"

116.speaker: Lucian Galade
116.text: "And that's not all. I found her resume on file and there's a year-long gap between her finishing secretarial school and beginning her career."

117.speaker: Lucian Galade
117.text: "Normally, this would have been looked into. But Miss Suno was hired before a background check could be completed. By one Petr Vectern."

118.speaker: Player
118.text: "I know. It sounds ridiculous to me as well."

119.speaker: Lucian Galade
119.text: "Miss Suno, indulge me for a moment. What were you doing in the year 1951?"

122.speaker: Livia Suno
122.text: "If you must know, I was working as a cigarette girl at Porto's. It's a Lachaven saloon. I was saving up so I could afford my own place in Holsord."

123.speaker: Livia Suno
123.text: "Here's the proprietor's number if you need to double check."

124.speaker: Livia Suno
124.text: "Mr. President, I understand if you don't want me to keep my job, but why smear me with outlandish accusations?"

125.speaker: Narrator
125.text: She scribbled a telephone number on a piece of paper. Lucian snatched it up.

126.speaker: Player
126.text: "But why have you been asking me so many questions about what I do?"

127.speaker: Player
127.text: "But why were you asking Petr about my alliances?"

128.speaker: Player
128.text: "But why were you so eager to help Deivid back in Benfi?"

129.speaker: Livia Suno
129.text: "To tell the truth, Mr. Rayne... I was hoping to run for office myself someday. I want to make a real difference in the world, like Ms. Morgna or Ms. Walda."

130.speaker: Livia Suno
130.text: "But I guess I messed that up by getting involved with Petr. Now they're all just going to say I slept my way to the top."

131.speaker: Livia Suno
131.text: "To tell the truth, Mr. Rayne... I was hoping to run for office myself someday. I want to make a real difference in the world, like Ms. Morgna or Ms. Walda."

132.speaker: Livia Suno
132.text: "But I guess I messed that up by getting involved with Petr. Now they're all just going to say I slept my way to the top."

133.speaker: Livia Suno
133.text: "But I guess I messed that up by getting involved with Petr. Now they're all just going to say I slept my way to the top."

134.speaker: Livia Suno
134.text: "To tell the truth, Mr. Rayne... I was hoping to run for office myself someday. I want to make a real difference in the world, like Ms. Morgna or Ms. Walda."

135.speaker: Livia Suno
135.text: "Wait. How did you know about that conversation?"

136.speaker: Narrator
136.text: There was a loud pounding on the door. Petr barged in without waiting for an answer. He was unshaven, and wore the same clothes as the night before.

137.speaker: Lucian Galade
137.text: "And your questioning Petr about Sordland's potential alliances?"

138.speaker: Lucian Galade
138.text: "And your questioning Petr about Sordland's potential alliances?"

139.speaker: Livia Suno
139.text: "I told you, I-- wait. How do you know about that?"

140.speaker: Livia Suno
140.text: "I told you, I-- wait. How do you know about that?"

141.speaker: Petr Vectern
141.text: "I came as soon as I heard the three of you were in here. Anton, what the hell are you doing? I told you I had this under control."

146.speaker: Narrator
146.text: Petr took a seat on the far end of the sofa. He looked over at Livia and noticed her troubled expression.

147.speaker: Petr Vectern
147.text: "God, why involve her? This is my mess. She did nothing wrong."

148.speaker: Player
148.text: "She's a spy, Petr. You messed up big-time."

149.speaker: Player
149.text: "Lucian has the preposterous idea that she's a spy."

150.speaker: Player
150.text: "Well... there's a small chance she could be a spy."

152.speaker: Lucian Galade
152.text: "I have reason to believe she's been relaying information to Rumburg. Information that you leaked to her in your carelessness."

153.speaker: Narrator
153.text: Lucian rewound his tape and played it again. As Petr listened, his eyes widened in disbelief.

154.speaker: Petr Vectern
154.text: "Lucian, you rat bastard. You've been bugging my office!"

156.speaker: Player
156.text: "Lucian, is this true? How could you?"

157.speaker: Player
157.text: "I'm sure there's an explanation for this."

158.speaker: Lucian Galade
158.text: "I had noticed the Vice President's behaviour becoming increasingly erratic and unprofessional over the past months. I wanted to get to the root of the cause."

159.speaker: Narrator
159.text: Both Petr and Livia were glaring at Lucian now. He looked unrepentant.

160.speaker: Petr Vectern
160.text: "So you wiretapped your own goddamn colleague? And for what? Have you been getting off on this, you pervert?"

161.speaker: Lucian Galade
161.text: "Certainly not. I believe that along with the Rumburg whistleblower's admission that there is a spy in the Palace and certain gaps in Miss Suno's resume, this tape makes a compelling case to investigate the secretary for espionage."

165.speaker: Lucian Galade
165.text: "Certainly not. I believe that along with certain gaps in Miss Suno's resume, this tape makes a compelling case to investigate the secretary for espionage."

166.speaker: Lucian Galade
166.text: "Whether or not the investigation yields positive results, Mr. Vectern ought to be held accountable for his willingness to divulge such sensitive information. He ought to stand trial or, at the very least, resign."

167.speaker: Narrator
167.text: Petr's jaw dropped. Livia stood up.

168.speaker: Livia Suno
168.text: "If I may, Mr. President. I've been paying attention to what goes on in the Palace. Not because I'm some sort of agent, but out of genuine interest. Hard as that may be for you to believe, Mr. Galade."

169.speaker: Livia Suno
169.text: "And from what I've seen, this man has been attempting to undermine your vice president at every turn. Perhaps with the goal of replacing Petr himself."

170.speaker: Narrator
170.text: She scowled at Lucian, then turned back to me.

171.speaker: Player
171.text: "Of course you'd say that. Petr's your lover."

172.speaker: Player
172.text: "That's ridiculous. I would never make Lucian vice president."

173.speaker: Player
173.text: "That actually makes a lot of sense."

175.speaker: Narrator
175.text: Lucian looked slightly shaken at that remark, but quickly regained his usual grace.

177.speaker: Narrator
177.text: Livia looked at Petr on the other end of the couch. Her eyes softened.

178.speaker: Livia Suno
178.text: "He *was* my lover. We've put this behind us. The two of you ought to do so as well."

179.speaker: Petr Vectern
179.text: "Loyal to you. It's true, he never could stand me."

180.speaker: Livia Suno
180.text: "Thank you. I'm happy someone at the Palace still takes me seriously."

182.speaker: Lucian Galade
182.text: "My personal misgivings about Mr. Vectern aside, I would never do anything to harm this administration."

183.speaker: Lucian Galade
183.text: "Mr. Vectern, on the other hand, has at best committed adultery, and at worst, delivered state secrets straight into enemy hands."

185.speaker: Player
185.text: "Lucian, can I speak to you alone for a moment?"

187.speaker: Player
187.text: "Petr and Livia, please wait outside while I try to talk some sense into Lucian."

188.speaker: Narrator
188.text: Petr and Livia exchanged worried glances before exiting my office.

189.speaker: Lucian Galade
189.text: "What are you going to do, Mr. President?"

190.speaker: Player
190.text: "I believe you. We should investigate Livia."

191.speaker: Player
191.text: "Honestly, I ought to fire you for surveilling Petr."

192.speaker: Player
192.text: "You're the strategist here, not me. You make the call."

193.speaker: Player
193.text: "I'm not investigating my own secretary. I won't play into your hands."

194.speaker: Lucian Galade
194.text: "What else could I have done? You couldn't look past your history together and see Mr. Vectern for who he truly is. You still can't."

195.speaker: Lucian Galade
195.text: "I already told you what we should do, sir. Investigate Miss Suno."

197.speaker: Narrator
197.text: Lucian breathed a sigh of relief.

198.speaker: Lucian Galade
198.text: "And Mr. Vectern? What will you do about his willingness to compromise Sordland's security at the drop of a pencil skirt?"

199.speaker: Player
199.text: "And if she does turn out to be a spy, and word gets out? I'll look like a fool."

200.speaker: Lucian Galade
200.text: "Not if Mr. Vectern shoulders the blame. As he should."

202.speaker: Player
202.text: "I'll decide that once we have the results."

203.speaker: Lucian Galade
203.text: "Very well. Just keep in mind you may need him to shoulder the blame for this."

205.speaker: Player
205.text: "True, he was the one who hired her..."

206.speaker: Player
206.text: "We'll decide that when the time comes."

207.speaker: Player
207.text: "Livia was right. You do have it out for him."

208.speaker: Player
208.text: "You might have a point. He's not the man he once was."

212.speaker: Player
212.text: "Evelyn also told me something to that effect."

214.speaker: Player
214.text: "Get a grip on yourself, Lucian. There is no spy."

215.speaker: Player
215.text: "Fine. Let's investigate her just to be on the safe side."

216.speaker: Lucian Galade
216.text: "Sir, do I have your permission to proceed with the investigation?"

218.speaker: Player
218.text: "No. Livia and Petr will continue working for me as usual. None of this happened."

219.speaker: Player
219.text: "Petr did what any man would. You'd understand if you weren't a workaholic."

220.speaker: Lucian Galade
220.text: "It's a legitimate orientation, sir. That aside, keep in mind you may well need Petr to shoulder the blame for this."

222.speaker: Lucian Galade
222.text: "I'll apologize to Miss Suno and tell her this has all been a misunderstanding. We can't have her running away during the investigation."

224.speaker: Lucian Galade
224.text: "I am only looking out for you, sir. The way I always do."

225.speaker: Lucian Galade
225.text: "He's exactly the man he once was. That's the problem."

226.speaker: Lucian Galade
226.text: "Just tell me, do I have your permission to launch an investigation into Miss Suno?"

229.speaker: Player
229.text: "No. Livia and Petr will continue working for me as usual. None of this happened."

232.speaker: Player
232.text: "Livia was right. You're completely off your rocker."

237.speaker: Player
237.text: "From now on, I'll ask when I want your advice."

238.speaker: Player
238.text: "I don't want to hear another word against either of them again."

239.speaker: Player
239.text: "This is my decision. I'll face the consequences."

241.speaker: Player
241.text: "No, I'll do it myself. She's too suspicious of you."

242.speaker: Player
242.text: "Fine. But I'm warning you -- don't spy on your colleagues. Ever again."

244.speaker: Narrator
244.text: Lucian gave a slight bow as he left the office.

245.speaker: Narrator
245.text: I sat by myself for a while, wondering what exactly I had set into motion.

246.speaker: Narrator
246.text: Lucian clenched his jaw. I'd never seen him this unhinged in all my years working with him.

248.speaker: Narrator
248.text: He stood up and stiffly walked out of the office.

249.speaker: Narrator
249.text: I was right to defend my secretary and my best friend. But I hoped I hadn't just made an enemy.

257.speaker: Petr Vectern
257.text: "I think Anton is making the moves to isolate Rumburg step by step:"

258.speaker: Petr Vectern
258.text: "We've opened two new lines of communication with Ventrie City and Kyow. Just exploratory talks at this point, but they might lead to something deeper."

265.speaker: Petr Vectern
265.text: "We lost our shot with the superpowers due to the embargoes. We're reviewing other options at the moment."

266.speaker: Petr Vectern
266.text: "The embargo reduced our chances with Arcasia. Although we've still got a shot with United Contana."
266.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Diplomacy_EmbargoingArcasia"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Diplomacy_EmbargoingUnitedContana"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Diplomacy_EmbargoingUnitedContana"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Diplomacy_EmbargoingArcasia"] == true)
